subject: Invitation | Encord's Sport's Analytics AI After Hours at Stamford Bridge
text:
Hi [NAME],

I hope this email finds you well! I'm reaching out as I wanted to
personally invite you to Encord's AI After Hours Sports Analytics panel on
June 18th at Stamford Bridge, Chelsea FC's stadium. I've personally been
following a lot of the AI and digital transformation work F1 are doing and
I think it's incredible work.

This particular AI After Hours is designed to bring together leaders across
AI, data, and sports technology for two short panels featuring speakers
from Genius Sports, Stats Perform, Hudl, The Premier League, Reading FC and
Nottingham Forest FC. The panel will be followed by an opportunity to
connect with peers over food, drinks, and networking in Chelsea's Canoville
Suite.

AI After Hours is Encord's event series focused on bringing together
practitioners and technical leaders working at the frontier of AI. Previous
events have featured speakers from Nvidia, BAE, Airbus, and other leading
organisations.

I thought this could be a great opportunity to connect with peers working
on building and improving their AI and Digital teams for their sports teams
in the space.

Please me know if you would be interested in attending, so I can send you
the invitation link to sign up. We would absolutely love to have you there.

subject: Annotation in-house then what?
text:
Hi [NAME],

We work with physical AI and worker-safety video teams including Pickle
Robot, Intenseye, and Voxel.

A pattern we see consistently: teams bring annotation in-house to fix
quality issues, then hit a new problem. The data pipeline starts consuming
more engineering time than the models - especially as each new site brings
different camera setups, lighting, and edge cases.

Would you be open to a 20-minute call to see how we helped those teams get
that time back?
